item.title: BASF opens $1B MDI production facility in Louisiana
item.description: The Geismar site is the Germany-based entity’s largest single investment to date in the United States and **, making it its most significant** MDI producer in North America.

item.title: Automakers using advanced tech to cut waste and costs, boost flexibility
item.description: Artificial intelligence can help companies enhance connectivity on the factory floor and optimize supply chains, experts said at the State of Automotive Manufacturing virtual event.
item.dc:creator: Jeff Kinney

item.title: Nvidia CEO resigns amid scandal; CFO named interim
item.description: Jensen Huang resigned effective immediately, with the chipmaker naming its long-time CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO until a permanent successor is found, Nvidia announced Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Maura Webber Sadovi

item.title: Anthropic launches ‘Claude for Manufacturing’
item.description: The new plugin with 17 skills and four connectors helps manufacturers draft quotes, quality reports and supplier requests from the systems they already run, the company said.
item.dc:creator: Jeff Kinney

item.title: CNH to sell 70% stake in construction equipment business
item.description: The heavy machinery maker plans to offload a majority stake to Kobelco for $700 million and focus solely on its agriculture business.
item.dc:creator: Nathan Owens

item.title: Bipartisan push possible to curb Trump tariffs
item.description: Three bills in Congress would significantly restrict presidential tariff power if they become law. Experts say there's appetite for change in trade policy.
item.dc:creator: Antone Gonsalves

item.title: Manufacturing advocates make case for tariffs following midterm results
item.description: Although polls show the public is tired of import taxes, rolling back trade enforcement would be a “serious mistake,” according to a report from the Alliance for American Manufacturing.
item.dc:creator: Nathan Owens

item.title: Mars to invest $1.4B in US manufacturing, operations in 2027
item.description: The investment, the largest made by the M&Ms maker in a single year, will help grow its snacking portfolio following its $36 billion acquisition of Kellanova.
